## How it was checked

- [ ] Tests for the changed behaviour (and a verification example for a new engineering result)
- [ ] `ruff` / `pytest` (python) or `eslint` / type check (workbench) for the changed files
- [ ] Walked in the app from a fresh project (for anything visible)

## House rules

- [ ] No code-specific branches in the engine or UI: values come from the code pack
- [ ] The feature lives in one part; other parts link to it
- [ ] User-visible strings localised; labels in title case
- [ ] No client data, secrets, personal paths or copied code texts
- [ ] An engineering decision, if any, is recorded in `docs/engineering-decisions.md`
